### Step 1 — Scene
A shredded vegetable salad/slaw, with small portions of pickled ginger and wasabi, plus an espresso. No meat or noodles are clearly identifiable.

### Step 2 — Vessels
- Main plate: approximately **26 cm** diameter; area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.
- Condiment cups: approximately **5 cm** diameter; area ≈ **20 cm²** each.
- Coffee cup: approximately **7 cm** internal diameter; area ≈ **38 cm²**.

### Steps 3–6 — Items, coverage, volume, and weight
The vegetables cover approximately **60% of the main plate**. Their allocated areas below sum to 60%; the dressing coats the vegetables rather than occupying additional plate area.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|
| Shredded cabbage/other pale-green vegetables | 40% of plate | 212 × 2.2 = 466 ml | 0.50 g/ml | 233 g |
| Shredded carrot | 12% of plate | 64 × 2.0 = 128 ml | 0.55 g/ml | 70 g |
| Bean sprouts | 8% of plate | 42 × 2.0 = 84 ml | 0.50 g/ml | 42 g |
| Light, oily dressing, suggested by the sheen | Overlapping vegetables | Thin coating, approximately 8 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 8 g |
| Pickled ginger | 60% of its cup | 12 × 2.0 = 24 ml | 0.70 g/ml | 17 g |
| Wasabi | 20% of its cup | 4 × 1.2 = 4.8 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 5 g |
| Espresso | 100% of cup interior | 38 × 1.1 = 42 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 42 g |

### Step 7 — Energy
| Item | kcal per 100 g | Estimated kcal |
|---|---:|---:|
| Cabbage/mixed pale-green vegetables | 25 | 58 |
| Carrot | 41 | 29 |
| Bean sprouts | 30 | 13 |
| Oily dressing | 600 | 48 |
| Pickled ginger | 60 | 10 |
| Wasabi paste | 150 | 8 |
| Espresso | 2 | 1 |

### Step 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **375 g of food**, plus **42 g of coffee**, is plausible for the visible mound and small condiments. Estimated energy is **about 167 kcal**, with the greatest uncertainty coming from the dressing.
